definitions.explanation: A person of higher status, rank, or age than oneself.

examples.japanese: {目上|めうえ}の{人|ひと}には{敬語|けいご}を{使|つか}う。
{目上|めうえ}に{対|たい}して{失礼|しつれい}だ。
{目上|めうえ}の{方|かた}からの{助言|じょげん}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Advice from those above you is valuable.

notes:
USAGE: {目上|めうえ} describes people who are senior in age, rank, or social position. Understanding {目上|めうえ} and {目下|めした} relationships is essential for proper use of keigo (polite language).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{目上|めうえ}の{人|ひと}/{方|かた} (a superior, senior person)
・{目上|めうえ}に{対|たい}して (toward one's superiors)

CONTRAST:
・{目上|めうえ} - superior, senior
・{目下|めした} - subordinate, junior
・{先輩|せんぱい} - senior (in school/work)
・{後輩|こうはい} - junior (in school/work)
